# ForgingStack Watchtower

> The agent that stops checking in IS the one you will hear about. Liveness attestation with alerts and receipts.

- Live API: https://forgingstack-watchtower.jkbattles.workers.dev
- Product page: https://forgingstack.com/work/watchtower/
- Public client repo: https://github.com/jdkabattles/forgingstack-watchtower
- MCP Registry: io.github.jdkabattles/forgingstack-watchtower

## Docs

- [README.md](https://github.com/jdkabattles/forgingstack-watchtower/blob/main/README.md) — signup, watch flow, price, files
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/jdkabattles/forgingstack-watchtower/blob/main/SKILL.md) — when to use it, how to read the result
- [agent-card.json](https://github.com/jdkabattles/forgingstack-watchtower/blob/main/agent-card.json) — A2A-style discovery card

## Facts

- 1 credit per watch; 1 credit per alert; check-ins are free.
- 100 free starter credits on signup; email verification required before the key can register watches.
- $10 for 1,000 credits.
- MCP tools: create_watch, check_in, get_watch, get_credits, get_receipt (stdio, stdlib only).
